title: 第七章 矛盾的王朝第八章 朕不求长生不死
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
“陆兄弟，你们暂且歇歇脚，我要回去复命了。”
“有什么需求，尽可吩咐这里的管事，想出去逛逛我们也不拦着，只莫犯了规矩便是……”
进了城，宁伯兴将陆俊峰一行带到一处驿站，便是提出了告别。
“是！”
“这一路劳烦将军了！”
“没事~”
眼见宁伯兴身影远去，众人紧绷的心弦才稍稍一松。
“师兄，这到底是怎么回事儿？”
“这……这地方太诡异了！”
“那人真是魔门中人么？这会不会是个圈套？”
“能否禀报宗门，请求援助？”
……
众人聚在了院子里，把守住门口，不住朝着陆俊峰询问着。
陆俊峰却未理会众人，目光径直投向其中一人：“白师弟，现在军队已经退去，虽仍有些压抑之感，但已经可以调动法力了，你再试试，可否召回冲云舟。”
冲云舟，宗主专门为此次航行炼制的上品法宝，如今他们流落异地，这飞舟便是归途唯一的指望。
而白逸之便是操纵冲云舟的弟子。
归来途中，由宁伯兴率领的八百禁军护卫，这些士兵虽无宁伯兴那般迫人的威压，但集结一处，却凝聚出一股铁血肃杀之气……钢铁之师，气势如虹！身处军阵之中，众修士竟如坠禁法领域，无边锐武煞气涌来，他们完全无法调动法力，与普通人无异。
苏醒之后白逸之曾离开队伍，尝试过唤回冲云舟，但是并无所获，而且还引起了宁伯兴的怀疑，之后再难有隐秘的机会。
这场旅途名义上是护送，其实也是监控。
直至此刻，在这驿站之内，陆俊峰一行才算勉强获得了一丝喘息之机，有了片刻私密空间。

白逸之闻言面色严肃，当即盘膝坐下，手掐印诀，口诵法咒。无形的微风悄然拂动，法力涟漪般自他身周荡漾开来……
众人屏息凝神，目光紧紧锁在白逸之身上，眼中满是希冀。
然而……过了一会儿，白逸之睁开双眼，迎着所有人的视线，颓然摇头：“师兄，我已彻底失去了对于冲云舟的感应。”
陆俊峰瞳孔骤然一缩：“什么？！白师弟，可是法诀有谬误？要不再试一次？”
白逸之摇头：“我已将运转法念诵二十三遍，断不可能有谬误，上次我好歹还能感受到冲云舟微弱联系，但是这次……我什么都感受不到了。”
“这……这怎么可能？！”
“白师兄，冲云舟可是宗主炼制的啊！魔门尊者的神通都能抗住，怎么会……”
白逸之的话如同一盆冷水浇下，扑灭了所有希望。
此时此刻，众人已然没了发现新大洲，立下滔天功劳的欢喜，有的只是前途灰暗的绝望。
没了冲云舟，就代表他们回不去了！
置身于这片陌生之地，他们该何去何从？
修行多年锤炼出的平稳心境，此刻都失了方寸。
“这地方太古怪了！一个王朝，怎么能发展成这样？”
“这究竟是什么鬼地方？！冲云舟好好的，怎么就被暗算了？”
“此地窝藏杀道魔头，怕是与魔门有勾结！师兄，咱们干脆跟他们拼了！”
有人惊慌失措，满目颓唐。亦有人怒发冲冠，戾气横生。没了外人之后，这些压抑已久的情绪，终于如决堤洪水般爆发出来。
“肃静！”
content_en:
"Brother Lu, you guys have a rest for now, I'm going back to resume my life."
"If you need anything, just ask the stewards here. If you want to go out for a walk, we won't stop you. Just don't break the rules..."
After entering the city, Ning Boxing took Lu Junfeng and his party to an inn and said goodbye.
"Yes!"
"I've troubled you all the way, General!"
"It's okay~"
Seeing Ning Boxing's figure disappearing away, everyone's tense heartstrings relaxed a little.
"Brother, what on earth is going on?"
"This... this place is so weird!"
"Is that person really a member of the Demon Sect? Could this be a trap?"
"Can you report it to the sect and ask for assistance?"
…
Everyone gathered in the yard, guarding the door, and kept asking Lu Junfeng.
Lu Junfeng ignored the crowd and looked directly at one of them: "Junior Brother Bai, now that the army has retreated, although it still feels a little depressed, it can already mobilize mana. You can try again to see if you can recall Chongyun Zhou."
Chongyunzhou was a high-grade magical weapon specially refined by the sect leader for this voyage. Now that they were living in a different place, this flying boat was their only hope for the return journey.
Bai Yizhi is the disciple who controls Chongyun Zhou.
On the way back, they were escorted by 800 forbidden troops led by Ning Boxing. Although these soldiers were not as oppressive as Ning Boxing, when gathered together, they condensed an iron-blooded killing aura... The steel division was as powerful as a rainbow! Being in the military formation, the monks felt as if they had fallen into the realm of forbidden magic. Boundless martial evil aura surged in. They were completely unable to mobilize their magic power and were no different from ordinary people.
After waking up, Bai Yizhi left the team and tried to recall Chong Yunzhou, but to no avail. It also aroused Ning Boxing's suspicion, and there would be no chance to keep secrets in the future.
This journey is nominally an escort, but in fact it is also surveillance.
Until now, in this inn, Lu Junfeng and his party could barely get a chance to breathe and have a moment of privacy.
Bai Yizhi looked serious when he heard this. He immediately sat down cross-legged, made seals with his hands, and recited the mantra. The invisible breeze blew quietly, and mana rippled around him...
Everyone held their breath and concentrated, their eyes tightly locked on Bai Yizhi, their eyes full of hope.
However... after a while, Bai Yizhi opened his eyes, faced everyone's gaze, and shook his head dejectedly: "Brother, I have completely lost my sense of Chong Yunzhou."
Lu Junfeng's pupils suddenly shrank: "What?! Junior Brother Bai, but there is a fallacy in the method? Do you want to try it again?"
Bai Yizhi shook his head: "I have recited the movement method twenty-three times, and there is absolutely no fallacy. Last time I could still feel the weak connection with Chongyun Zhou, but this time... I can't feel anything."
"This...how is this possible?!"
"Senior Brother Bai, Chong Yunzhou was refined by the sect master! The Lord of the Demon Sect can withstand the magical power, how could it be..."
Bai Yizhi's words were like a basin of cold water poured down, extinguishing all hope.
At this moment, everyone no longer had the joy of discovering a new continent and making huge achievements, but only the despair of a gloomy future.
Without Chong Yunzhou, it means they can't go back!
In this strange land, where should they go?
The stable state of mind that I had cultivated over many years of practice was now gone.
"This place is so weird! How could a dynasty develop like this?"
"What the hell is this place?! Chong Yunzhou was fine, so why was he plotted?"
"There are murderous demons hiding here, and I'm afraid they are colluding with the demon sect! Senior brother, let's just fight them!"
Some people were panic-stricken and looked dejected. There are also people who are furious and full of violence. After there were no outsiders, these long-suppressed emotions finally burst out like a flood.
"quiet!"
